statement: There are 552 irreducible rational plane curves of degree 4 through 8 general points with contact order 4 to a fixed line at an unspecified point of the line.

source.location: Corollary 4.8; Theorem 4.9, equation (4.6); Figure 8, d=3,4 rows

origin.inheritance_basis: Use d*z(d) with d=4; z(2)=1 follows from the recurrence and Figure 8 gives z(3)=7,z(4)=138.
